- Tarsal bones: 7 (talus, calcaneus, navicular, cuboid, 3 cuneiforms)
- Metatarsal bones: 5
- Phalanges: 14 (2 in the big toe, 3 in each of the other 4 toes)

Total: 7 + 5 + 14 = 26 bones per foot.

So the adult human foot has 26 bones.
